messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] spatial temporal model

On 30 November 2012 09:47, jones <jonesmu...@gmail.com> wrote:
> am getting this error but i cannot figure out what am doing wrong. can some
> one help

You are supplying two A-matrices (A.est and 1=identity) but only one
set of covariates.
This is a single list: c(field.indices, list(Intercept=1))
If you don't have any other covariates in the model, you just need to
drop the second A-matrix.
If you have any observation-specific covariates, add them in a second
list, like this:

effects=
list(c(field.indices, list(Intercept=1)),
list(other.covariate=something) )

/Finn
